label: D1 after a common a2->S2 trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2). It needs the previous trial to have been a2 with a common transition to S2: activation is essentially zero after any a1 trial or after a rare a2->S1 trial. It is also confined to the first part of the episode. Rate is about 0.11 to 0.22 per D1 in trials 1 to 29, falls off through trials 30 to 49, and is zero after trial 60. It does not fire on episode trial 0. It fires after both rewarded and unrewarded previous trials. Rewarded ones carry more mass (in_rew=1 holds 66% of the mass and has a 3.3x lift). Active steps coincide with a moderate a2-leaning policy logit (choice in [-4.4, -1.5]) and mid-range value (7.5 to 7.7). Adding these conditions did not improve F1. All predicate variables are observed. Dev scores were P 0.76, R 0.70, F1 0.73, mass recall 0.72. Most misses are rel -3 D1 steps, where the previous trial falls outside the window and prev_action is unknown. Adding (prev_action == -1) as a disjunct raises dev mass recall to 0.95 but lowers precision to 0.58. The recorded predicate leaves that clause out. The feature is plausibly a timer for the early episode gated by the last common a2->S2 transition.
